picks.question: Will the rate of CPI inflation be above 3.5% for the year ending in September 2026?
picks.why: Inflation still above 3.5% would constrain Fed rate cuts and signal that tariff and price pressures persist into 2027.

picks.question: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by December 31?
picks.why: Roughly a fifth of global oil passes through Hormuz, so prolonged disruption keeps energy prices, shipping costs, and inflation elevated.

picks.question: Billionaire one-time wealth tax passes in California election 2026?
picks.why: A state billionaire wealth tax would test capital flight, revenue estimates, and public appetite for taxing wealth rather than income.

picks.question: Will an AI lab announce another Millennium Prize solution by December 31, 2027?
picks.why: AI resolving a famous open math problem would mark a leap in machine reasoning, with implications for research productivity.

picks.question: Will Anthropic have the best AI model at the end of December 2026?
picks.why: Leadership at the AI frontier shapes where investment, talent, and market power concentrate in a fast-growing industry.

picks.question: Will OpenAI’s market cap be $1.5T or greater at market close on IPO day by December 31, 2027?
picks.why: An IPO valued above $1.5 trillion would gauge investor conviction in AI economics and could shift index weights and capital flows.
